name: Pope Zacarias
source:
The former pope who reigned about 1300 years ago.
He is said to have been involved in Uriel's falling as an angel, the truth behind this incident and his existence are deep-rooted mysteries.

[translated from [url=http://maria.karin-e.jp/03_character/other_htm/04zacarias.htm]official website[/url].]
